game.name: Crash Time II (Europe)(En,Fr,De)
game.desc: Crash Time II on Xbox 360 is directly inspired by the Cobra Alert series. You play as one of the two cops of the shock duo and must complete as many missions as possible, sometimes on German motorways, sometimes in the city. At the wheel of big German sedans, the player alternates between checkpoint races, patrols and car chases. The game includes a multiplayer mode where four users can compete in split screen mode.
